thread:
Mira: Quick sync — SecureEdge wants a joint GCP Marketplace listing + co-demo for their Edge Secrets SI next quarter. They need SSO (SAML IdP/SP), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM keywrap (KMIP). Can we map owners and realistic timeline? I'm thinking security review by 2024-04-07, integration POC by 2024-04-21, marketing assets by 2024-05-05. Thoughts? @Lina @Omar @Ashley

Lina: I'm in. I'll own SCIM + SAML mapping. Need their SP metadata XML and sample group schema. Any constraints on SCIM custom attrs from our side?

Omar: I'll take the security review + HSM/KMS tech check. Quick Q: do they require BYOK for customers or just wrapped keys via KMIP? If BYOK we need a KMS policy template and docs on key lifecycle. Also need their threat model + data flow diagram.

Mira: Partner said they'll prefer BYOK for enterprise customers but want hosted keys for demo — so we should plan for both flows.

Ashley: I'll draft announcement timeline. Marketing requests: partner logo, 2-line blurb, a one-pager, and a screenshot for the Marketplace tile. We should avoid locking GA until compliance is green.

Lina: Can they provide a service account for SCIM with write scope? I'll create test fixtures once we have endpoints. Also FYI SecureEdge uses `externalId` as primary key instead of `id` — that'll need a mapping layer.

Omar: Also need HSM vendor certs and keywrap algos (RSA-OAEP, AES-KW?). If they use PKCS#11 on-prem, our connector must support PKCS#11 or KMIP. Ping infra for network/egress rules.

Mira: Good call. @deploy-bot adding labels: partnership/secureedge, security-review. Doc link: https://redwood-internal/partners/secureedge-integration (private)

deploy-bot: Label applied: partnership/secureedge, security-review

Lina: Small gotcha observed — their SCIM user payload nests group membership as `groups.externalId`. I'll add a mapping snippet. Example mapping we'll use:
```json
{"id":"scim_id","externalId":"partner_id","displayName":"name","groups":[{"externalId":"g-123","display":"eng"}]}
```

Omar: Minimal KMS IAM template for demo: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key ring, plus a rotate policy (30d). For BYOK we'll add `roles/cloudkms.viewer` to support key import checks. I'll drop a template in the doc.

Ashley: Partner suggested May 10-12 for co-demo slot. Can we tentatively reserve May 10 for internal dry-run and May 11 for partner-facing demo?

Mira: May 10 internal dry-run works. Public co-announce targeted end of May pending security signoff and partner legal.

Lina: I'll spin up the SCIM test tenant and share creds by EOD Friday.

Omar: Scheduled threat-model review Thu 10:00am PT. Invite sent to Lina, Mira, and infra. Agenda: SAML metadata exchange, SCIM schema, KMS/HSM keywrap options.

Mira: Perfect. Next sync Thu 10:00am PT. Please bring any non-blocking ask items to the doc before then. :white_check_mark:
